title: Diamond Hallucinations
description: Turn glow lichen into diamonds and prank your friends!
body:
# 💎 Diamond Hallucinations

Have you ever found diamonds in Minecraft, but it turned out to be glow lichen? Well I have too... and that's why I decided to make it 5x worse!

With this Minecraft resource pack, you can make glow lichen look just like diamonds! Perfect to troll your friends!

Here's some images:
